claim_text: 58% worried about what is real and fake online when it comes to news
Four in 10 adults encountered misinformation or deepfake content in previous four weeks
Among those who encountered it, 71% say they have seen it online
38% say they often come across made-up news and information
32% often see political news stories online that are made up
23% say they have themselves shared made-up news
36% often or very often exposed to disinformation and fake news over past seven days
66% think exposed to disinformation and fake news at least sometimes over past seven days
37% of respondents come across fake news daily or every other day
80% reported seeing misleading false or inaccurate online information at least once a month
47% find it harder to distinguish between true and false news than three years prior
72% of adults believe they encountered some form of misinformation on a platform
64% of Facebook users encountered misinformation on the platform over six months
